info.description: FHIR web services used to access terminology data.
info.title: Terminology FHIR API

get.summary: Retrieves a list of code systems
get.description: Retrieves a list of code systems matching the provided search criteria.

parameters.name: auth
parameters.description: basic access authentication credentials, specified as username:password and encoded using Base64 encoding. These credentials can alternatively be passed in the 'Authorization: Basic' HTTP header.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: The name of the code system. By default, this filter matches a code system if its name equals or starts with the supplied parameter value. Also supports the :contains and :exact modifiers.

parameters.name: _sort
parameters.description: Indicates which order to return the results. Terminology Gateway currently only supports sorting on a single field, not chained sort rules.

parameters.name: _pretty
parameters.description: Non-standard parameter to request that responses be pretty-printed.

get.summary: Retrieves a single code system by id
get.description: Retrieves a single code system corresponding to the provided id.

parameters.name: auth
parameters.description: basic access authentication credentials, specified as username:password and encoded using Base64 encoding. These credentials can alternatively be passed in the 'Authorization: Basic' HTTP header.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The code system identifier. Either the OID or the name are considered valid identifiers.

parameters.name: _summary
parameters.description: Requests that the server return a subset of the resource.  Code System concepts are omitted if set to true.

parameters.name: _pretty
parameters.description: Non-standard parameter to request that responses be pretty-printed.

get.summary: Retrieves a single concept from a code system
get.description: Given a code and a code system, get additional details about the concept, including definition, status, designations, and properties.

parameters.name: auth
parameters.description: basic access authentication credentials, specified as username:password and encoded using Base64 encoding. These credentials can alternatively be passed in the 'Authorization: Basic' HTTP header.

parameters.name: code
parameters.description: The code that is to be located.

parameters.name: system
parameters.description: The URI of the code system for the code that is to be located.  If using the code system OID, it must be in the URI format urn:oid:[oid-value]

parameters.name: version
parameters.description: The version of the code system.

parameters.name: _pretty
parameters.description: Non-standard parameter to request that responses be pretty-printed.

404.description: Unknown code, code system identifier, or code system version.

404.description: Unknown code, code system identifier, or code system version.

get.summary: Translate a code from one value set to another, based on the existing value set and concept maps resources
get.description: The operation returns a set of parameters including a 'result' for whether there is an acceptable match.

parameters.name: auth
parameters.description: basic access authentication credentials, specified as username:password and encoded using Base64 encoding. These credentials can alternatively be passed in the 'Authorization: Basic' HTTP header.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The concept map identifier. Either the OID or the name are considered valid identifiers.

parameters.name: code
parameters.description: The code that is to be translated.

parameters.name: system
parameters.description: The system for the code that is to be translated

parameters.name: version
parameters.description: The version of the system, if one was provided in the source data

parameters.name: reverse
parameters.description: if this is true, then the operation should return all the codes that might be mapped to this code.

parameters.name: _pretty
parameters.description: Non-standard parameter to request that responses be pretty-printed.

404.description: Unknown code, code system identifier, or code system version.

get.summary: Retrieves a list of value sets
get.description: Retrieves a list of value sets matching the provided search criteria.

parameters.name: auth
parameters.description: basic access authentication credentials, specified as username:password and encoded using Base64 encoding. These credentials can alternatively be passed in the 'Authorization: Basic' HTTP header.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: The name of the value set. Regular expression format is allowed for this parameter.

parameters.name: date
parameters.description: The value set publication date. The expected format is 'yyyy-MM-dd'.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: The status of the value set.

parameters.name: _sort
parameters.description: Indicates which order to return the results. Terminology Gateway currently only supports sorting on a single field, not chained sort rules.

parameters.name: _count
parameters.description: Enables pagination by providing a hint to the server regarding how many resources should be returned in a single page.

parameters.name: _pretty
parameters.description: Non-standard parameter to request that responses be pretty-printed.

get.summary: Retrieves a single value set by id including all active concepts
get.description: Retrieves a single value set corresponding to the provided id. The value set is expanded, and includes all active concepts.

parameters.name: auth
parameters.description: basic access authentication credentials, specified as username:password and encoded using Base64 encoding. These credentials can alternatively be passed in the 'Authorization: Basic' HTTP header.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: value set identifier. Either the OID or the name are considered valid identifiers.

parameters.name: filter
parameters.description: A text filter that is applied to restrict the names of the codes that are returned. Regular expression format is allowed for this parameter.

parameters.name: date
parameters.description: The date for which the expansion should be generated. The expected format is 'yyyy-MM-dd'.

parameters.name: displayLanguage
parameters.description: Specifies the language to be used for description in the expansions i.e. the language to be used for ValueSet.expansion.contains.display. (default = en)

parameters.name: _pretty
parameters.description: Non-standard parameter to request that responses be pretty-printed.

get.summary: Validates that a single code is a member of a value set
get.description: Validates that a single code is a member of a value set

parameters.name: auth
parameters.description: basic access authentication credentials, specified as username:password and encoded using Base64 encoding. These credentials can alternatively be passed in the 'Authorization: Basic' HTTP header.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: value set identifier. Either the OID or the name are considered valid identifiers.

parameters.name: code
parameters.description: The code that is to be validated.

parameters.name: system
parameters.description: The code system id for the code that is to be validated.

parameters.name: display
parameters.description: The display associated with the code, if provided.

parameters.name: date
parameters.description: The date for which the validation should be checked. Normally, this is the current conditions (which is the default values) but under some circumstances, systems need to validate that a correct code was used at some point in the past. The expected format is 'yyyy-MM-dd'.

parameters.name: displayLanguage
parameters.description: Non-standard parameter. Specifies the language to be used for description in the validation i.e. the language to be used for ValueSet.expansion.contains.display. (default = en)

parameters.name: _pretty
parameters.description: Non-standard parameter to request that responses be pretty-printed.
